title: AMConnect – Quick Survey
intro: We are developing AMConnect, an ASEAN-wide minerals knowledge and information platform. Tell us what information would help you most when assessing investment opportunities in critical minerals in the region.
thanks: Your answers will help shape AMConnect.

questions.text: What information would be most valuable to you when assessing investment opportunities in critical minerals in ASEAN?
questions.hint: Tap up to 3, most important first. Include information that is hard to find or not available today.

options.label: Geological data, resources and mineral potential
Mining, processing and refining projects (status, ownership)
Mining regulations, licensing and fiscal terms
ESG performance, environmental and social risks

questions.text: Which of these are hardest for you to access today?
What would make AMConnect most useful to you?
questions.hint: Tap up to 3, most useful first.

options.label: Country and project profiles you can compare
Contacts at government agencies or projects

questions.text: Which AI features would be most useful to you?
questions.hint: Tap up to 3, most useful first.

options.label: Opportunity mapping based on your company profile
Report summaries with links to sources

questions.text: Anything else you would like to tell us?
questions.hint: Optional. Add any information or comments, for example, data you need or how you would use AMConnect.

questions.text: Would you like to tell us a little about yourself?
questions.hint: Optional. For example, your name, organisation, designation and country, and whether we may contact you.
